summary: Attempt #3 at reproducing the hooks/*.mjs no-console condition: routes NoConsoleLauncher.exe through Node's own detached:true+stdio:'ignore' spawn (the same mechanism proven to produce a real flash for the daemon shape) instead of PowerShell's Start-Process launching it directly — attempt #2 (Start-Process) still left pwsh's own console reachable in the chain since a plain launch doesn't sever inheritance the way an explicit detach does. Still came back inconclusive; see NoConsoleLauncher.cs's note and the flow note for why.
